crossRefs.note: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their…
His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
“Judah, your brothers will praise you. Your hand will be on the neck of your enemies. Your father’s sons will bow down…
For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—
May Yahweh increase you more and more, you and your children.
For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

translations.web: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.
translations.bsb: These were the clans of Judah, and their registration numbered 76,500.
translations.kjv: These are the families of Judah according to those that were numbered of them, threescore and sixteen thousand and five hundred.
